🎬 Supercop (1992)

🎬 Movie
⭐️ Genre: Action, Comedy, Crime, Thriller
🎭 Starring: Jackie Chan, Michelle Yeoh, Maggie Cheung

📝 Summary:
Supercop follows Inspector Chan Ka-Kui, an elite Hong Kong police officer assigned to infiltrate a powerful international drug syndicate. Teaming up with fearless Chinese officer Jessica Yang, Ka-Kui embarks on a dangerous undercover mission that takes him across multiple countries. As their cover begins to unravel, the duo must rely on their courage, skill, and teamwork to bring down the criminal empire.

🔥 Why Watch?

* Jackie Chan’s legendary stunt work
* Incredible action sequences and breathtaking chases
* Outstanding chemistry between Jackie Chan and Michelle Yeoh
* Fast-paced story packed with suspense and humor
* One of the best films in the Police Story franchise

🏆 Rating: 7.1/10 (IMDb)
